mappings.sourceLocator: Software Design Document §4.2.2, printed pp.10–11, PDF pp.18–19
mappings.originalMeaning: CIC-mediated members may be visible or opaque to an ISA network
mappings.nonEquivalenceWarning: Composition member may be software or non-ISA; visibility does not establish physical containment

mappings.sourceLocator: Data Model Specification §7.3 Observable Declaration, printed p.72, PDF p.87; §6.2 Config.ccd, printed p.58, PDF p.73
mappings.originalMeaning: Declares typed observables that a component can publish in Event messages
mappings.nonEquivalenceWarning: Declared field is not a performed reading, physical channel or CSAPI DataStream result schema

mappings.sourceLocator: Data Model Specification §7.3 Capability Declaration, printed p.70, PDF p.85; §6.2 Config.ccd, printed p.58, PDF p.73; ICD §6.4, printed p.20, PDF p.28
mappings.originalMeaning: Declares supported properties, observables, commands and custom types
mappings.nonEquivalenceWarning: Not a complete operating-mode register, the currently selected setting or proof of execution

mappings.sourceLocator: Data Model Specification §6.2 Status, printed p.61, PDF p.76; ICD §6.5, printed pp.21–22, PDF pp.29–30
mappings.originalMeaning: Reports component property values and heartbeat-related status
mappings.nonEquivalenceWarning: Only a specifically declared mode property could convey a mode; Status does not itself establish a mode or independent health truth

mappings.sourceLocator: Data Model Specification §6.2 Request, printed pp.59–60, PDF pp.74–75; ICD §6.7, printed pp.23–25, PDF pp.31–33
mappings.originalMeaning: Specifies a command request, name, parameters and optional timing
mappings.nonEquivalenceWarning: A message type or declared command does not establish a particular issued/authorized/executed real-world action

mappings.sourceLocator: Data Model Specification §6.2 Response, printed p.60, PDF p.75; ICD §6.7.1 Table 23, printed pp.24–25, PDF pp.32–33
mappings.originalMeaning: Reports queued, in-progress or final command execution status correlated to a request
mappings.nonEquivalenceWarning: Response Success is a reported disposition, not independently observed physical effect
